C0066.title: Hainan Man Sentenced for Fraud via Fake Second-Hand Billiard Cue Ads
C0066.summary: In August 2025, Hinews, Hainan Political and Legal Affairs Network, and other outlets reported that a Lingao man surnamed Lao posted fake second-hand billiard cue advertisements on Douyin and defrauded a victim surnamed Yin of RMB 3,400. Lingao County People's Court convicted Lao of fraud, sentenced him to four months of criminal detention, and fined him RMB 1,000.
